page_title: STR 1-2 BRE | Strasbourg v Brest 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Bastien Dechepy has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' The foul by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) was seen by Bastien Dechepy who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+2' Kenny Lala (Brest) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+2' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
88' Strasbourg keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
84' Martial Godo will be replaced by Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg).
84' Referee Bastien Dechepy signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Brest players have a reason to celebrate!
83' The goal for Brest is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
82' 1 - 2 Absolutely fantastic goal! Hugo Magnetti (Brest) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies into the top right corner. Take a bow.
81' Emmanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) executes a long-range free kick. His well-taken effort flies only inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Tousart (Brest) will replace Kamory Doumbia.
76' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Romain Del Castillo will be replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).
74' A dangerous looking corner kick from Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) is cleared to safety by the defence.

73' Gregoire Coudert pulls off a fantastic save! Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. Strasbourg win a corner.
73' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
69' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Ben Chilwell and he is replaced by Emmanuel Emegha (Strasbourg).
69' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
67' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
65' It's time for a substitution. Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) comes on in place of Pathe Mboup.
64' Kenny Lala (Brest) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
59' The keeper makes a simple save after Pathe Mboup (Brest) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
57' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Kendry Paez is replaced by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martial Godo (Strasbourg) is coming onto the pitch as Samuel Amo-Ameyaw cannot continue after picking up an injury.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mike Penders into the bottom right corner.
54' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is going to take the penalty!

53' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Bastien Dechepy blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. It's a penalty for Brest!
49' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eric Roy probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Brendan Chardonnet. He is replaced by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+1' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the roof of the net, but Gregoire Coudert pulls off a great save to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
44' Brest try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
44' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastien Dechepy saw the whole situation. Strasbourg get a free kick.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.

40' A big opportunity is wasted by Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Gregoire Coudert pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Strasbourg will take a corner.
39' Joris Chotard (Brest) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
37' Bastien Dechepy blows the whistle, Daouda Guindo (Brest) is penalised for a foul.
35' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) dribbles into the box, but Gregoire Coudert is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
30' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the left post is comfortably saved by Gregoire Coudert.
28' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the crossbar. Good effort!
27' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
25' Brest are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
20' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
15' It looks like Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) saw red with that tackle. Bastien Dechepy won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
14' The free kick from long range, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' 1 - 0 It's 1:0! Ben Chilwell feeds Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top of the net.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) is penalised for holding. Bastien Dechepy signals a set piece. Brest have a free kick.
5' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
4' Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy will referee today's match.
